title: Montezuma County Lodging Tax Ballot Issue 1B
scopeNote: County lodging-tax voting territory. The tax question expressly excludes the City of Cortez, and the official Cortez sample omits this question. Do not attach to all county residents or substitute another existing division; confirm the exact eligible territory and provide a matching geographic scope.
questionText: SHALL MONTEZUMA COUNTY LODGING TAXES BE INCREASED BY $404,598 IN TAX COLLECTION YEAR 2027 AND BY WHATEVER AMOUNTS ARE GENERATED ANNUALLY THEREAFTER BY INCREASING THE COUNTY LODGING TAX FROM 2% TO 5% EFFECTIVE JANUARY 1, 2027, EXCLUDING THE MUNICIPALITY OF CORTEZ WHICH HAS ITS OWN LODGING TAX, AND SHALL THE LODGING TAX REVENUES RECEIVED BY THE COUNTY BE USED FOR THE FOLLOWING PURPOSES: • TOURISM PROMOTION AND MARKETING; • RECREATION, OUTDOOR RECREATION, AND VISITOR-RELATED INFRASTRUCTURE IMPROVEMENTS; • DESTINATION DEVELOPMENT PROJECTS AND VISITOR EXPERIENCE ENHANCEMENTS; • TOURISM RESILIENCY, EMERGENCY RESPONSE, AND RECOVERY EFFORTS RELATED TO EVENTS AFFECTING VISITATION; • ADMINISTRATION, OVERSIGHT, AND IMPLEMENTATION OF AUTHORIZED LODGING TAX PROGRAMS; AND SHALL THE COUNTY BE AUTHORIZED TO COLLECT, RETAIN, AND SPEND ALL REVENUES GENERATED BY SUCH TAX AS A VOTER- APPROVED REVENUE CHANGE UNDER ARTICLE X, SECTION 20 OF THE COLORADO CONSTITUTION, OR ANY OTHER LAW?

measureRecord.whatItDoes: Increase the county lodging tax from 2% to 5% beginning January 1, 2027, excluding Cortez, which has its own lodging tax. The question authorizes $404,598 in additional taxes in 2027 and whatever amounts the tax generates later, with no stated end date. Uses would include tourism promotion; recreation and visitor-related infrastructure; destination development and visitor-experience projects; tourism resiliency, emergency response and recovery related to events affecting visits; and administering and overseeing authorized lodging-tax programs. All revenue generated by the tax could be collected, retained and spent outside the stated constitutional and other legal limits.
measureRecord.yesMeans: Approve the county lodging-tax increase outside Cortez for the stated purposes and its revenue-limit exception.
measureRecord.noMeans: Do not approve this county lodging-tax increase or its proposed revenue-limit exception.
